## Contributor checklist
- [ ] Added or updated `content/ecosystem/<id>.json`
- [ ] Filename matches `id` (`my-app.json` for `id: "my-app"`)
- [ ] `description` and `cta` are Spanish; CTA is a verb, not a URL
- [ ] No numeric APY or 1:1 peg claim in the copy
- [ ] `copmUsage.chains` includes `celo` and `evidenceUrl` is https
- [ ] Live URL works in production
- [ ] I read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/celocol/COPmHUB/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally
